name: Revenge Of A Futa
source:
After losing her father at a young age and spending years struggling to earn the approval of a new family that never truly accepted her, Jade is finally given the chance to rewrite her story. With newfound power in her hands, she must decide: will she rise above the pain and forgive those who wronged her, or will she embrace vengeance and make them all pay?

Now that she's finally made it to college—surrounded by horny, unfaithful girls and outspoken anti-futa activists—how will Jade handle the awakening of her deepest desires?

[From [url=https://ladylyris.itch.io/revengeofafuta]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰德年轻时就失去了父亲，并花了数年时间努力赢得一个从未真正接受她的新家庭的认可，杰德终于有机会重写她的故事。手中掌握了新的权力，她必须做出决定：她会克服痛苦并原谅那些冤枉她的人，还是会拥抱复仇并让他们付出代价？

现在，她终于进入了大学——周围都是饥渴、不忠的女孩和直言不讳的反futa活动人士——杰德将如何应对她最深层次欲望的觉醒？
